name: rfdiffusion3_design
description: Design protein backbones with RFdiffusion3. Either give a 'length' to build an unconditional backbone of that size, or a 'contigs' string with an 'input_pdb' to scaffold a motif out of an existing structure. Returns per-design metrics; the mmCIF text itself is opt-in.

length.description: Backbone length for unconditional design: '60', or a sampled range '60-100'. Maximum 400.

contigs.description: Motif-scaffolding contig string, e.g. '10-40/A163-181/10-40'. Requires input_pdb.

input_pdb.description: Path to the input structure the contigs refer to. Required with 'contigs', and must be readable by the provider.

n_designs.description: How many backbones to sample (default 1, max 8).

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed reproduces the designs.

return_structures.description: Return the mmCIF text of every backbone (default false: megabytes).
